title: Leave Codex webSearch items out of Engram test-check overlap tracking
outcome: Codex webSearch items go through command_started/command_completed, so note_engram_command_started counts them as commands: they mark open test checks overlapped (outcome unknown) and add a running key, though a search cannot write the worktree. Conservative, but it downgrades evidence. Give non-shell items a recorder path that skips the Engram notes (or mark only for commandExecution and file changes). Raised by the Claude round-5 /review-code of tm-winf steps 2+3.
